ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014 and Law No. 83 of 2016; Executive Regulation issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 17 of 2015; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations concerning Beneficial Ownership disclosure; Law No. 159 of 1981 (Companies Law) for LLC formation; Law No. 34 of 1976 on Commercial Registry.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized and consular-legalized Power of Attorney appointing the Egyptian formation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the UBO's country of residence and Egyptian Consulate/Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization; Hague Apostille is not accepted because Egypt is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of all proposed shareholders, UBOs, directors and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National identity-issuing authority or certified notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified bank reference letter or recent business bank statements evidencing source of funds and commercial activity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution holding the beneficial owner's account

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized UBO Declaration and AML/CFT compliance questionnaire
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Proposed shareholders/UBOs executed before an Egyptian or foreign notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every UBO, director, manager and authorized signatory against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, Egyptian CBE/EFIU domestic blacklists, and Egyptian terrorism lists under Law No. 80 of 2002. PEP status and close family/associates of politically exposed persons must be flagged and require enhanced due diligence and senior management approval before proceeding with incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Investor Services One-Stop Shop and Ministry of Trade and Industry Commercial Registry Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory registered company name must be in Arabic and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing name on the Commercial Registry. An English transliteration may be registered as an auxiliary name only. The LLC legal form indicator must appear in the Arabic name; brand names used by Amazon FBA sellers may be added only if transliterated and not misleading.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank and its Arabic equivalent 'بنك' (requires prior Central Bank of Egypt licensing)
Insurance/Takaful and Arabic equivalent 'تأمين' (requires prior Financial Regulatory Authority licensing)
Ministry, Government, General Authority or any public-office title, including 'وزارة', 'حكومة', 'جهاز' (unlawful without express government authorization)
National symbols, governorate names, and references to foreign states without prior Ministry of Foreign Affairs approval
Religious titles or phrases such as 'Islam/إسلام' or sacred designations, requiring review by the competent sectarian affairs body
Words indicating regulated activities such as pharmaceutical, medical, securities, funds or scientific research without prior sectoral ministerial clearance
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant may submit a written administrative appeal in Arabic to GAFI's Grievance Committee within 30 calendar days of rejection, attaching the official rejection notice, amended search results, alternative names, and a legal memorandum distinguishing the name from the conflicting registry entry. The Committee must decide within 15 business days. If still rejected, a final appeal may be filed before the competent Administrative Court of the State Council.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not accepted as a sole registered office. An LLC must maintain a physical registered address in Egypt for service of process and statutory correspondence. A virtual office, registered agent, or business-center address may be used only for supplementary correspondence if the company also maintains a verifiable physical premises; no virtual-office exemption exists for marketplace FBA sellers.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 10-20% probability of unannounced inspection by GAFI or Egyptian Tax Authority within the first three years for a low-risk e-commerce LLC. The likelihood increases to approximately 35% if the declared address is shared, lacks commercial character, or if records are inconsistent with the declared ISIC 4791 marketplace activity, including FBA import and delivery flows.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egypt Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended by Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; Articles of Association regulations for Limited Liability Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Companies Registry, with subsequent Commercial Registration at the Ministry of Trade and Industry Commercial Registry Office
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association (Aqd El-Ta'sis) and Articles of Association / Internal Bylaws (Eishrat El-Nizam)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an Egyptian LLC; the founding quota-holders may determine initial capital, which must be subscribed in full and paid in cash or in-kind. If the partners elect to use a notarial escrow arrangement, funds must be deposited into a blocked bank account until GAFI registration approval is obtained.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF EG_LLC: The founding quota-holders resolve that the company is hereby formally incorporated under Egypt Companies Law No. 159 of 1981. The issued and subscribed quota capital shall be allocated and paid as stated in the Memorandum of Association and its Schedules. The registered office shall be adopted at the address set out in the Company's Memorandum and shall remain the company's official venue. QUOTA-HOLDER APPOINTMENTS: Executive Manager, Chief Financial Officer, and Corporate Secretary are appointed to act on behalf of the company. The Executive Manager is authorized to sign operational documents, open bank accounts, and engage professional advisors, and to take all actions necessary for statutory filings and day-to-day administration. The resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability application through the GAFI portal with three alternative company names in Arabic, followed by a Latin transliteration. The name must not conflict with existing trademarks or registered trade names. After approval, reserve the name and generate a validation receipt.
required_dossiers: Proposed company names (Arabic and transliterated Latin)
Passport or national ID of founding quota-holders
Power of attorney if submission is made by an agent
Preliminary verification payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to similarity, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration within 15 days or submit a revised alternative name list without an additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in Arabic, defining quota allocations, management powers, registered office, and issue of quota shares. The documentation must be printed, signed by each founding quota-holder or their duly appointed attorney, and notarized before a licensed Egyptian notary public. The notarized instruments must then be stamped by the relevant revenue stamp office.
required_dossiers: Original reserved-name approval certificate
Quota-holder constitutional instruments and IDs
Memorandum of Association draft and Articles of Association draft
Declaration of address of registered office
Notarization and stamp tax payment receipts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries any inconsistency in capital allocation or management clauses, the founders may execute a notarized correction annex amending the relevant clause before re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Application and Issuance of Certificate of Formation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Memorandum, Articles, and all supporting documents through the GAFI electronic incorporation portal or in person at the GAFI one-stop shop. GAFI will verify compliance with Companies Law, approve the entity, and issue the Certificate of Incorporation listing the company's trade register data.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
Authenticated identity documents of quota-holders
Board resolution appointing the initial management
Name-reservation certificate
Duly notarized power of attorney, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a query or deficiency letter, the founders have 30 days to cure the deficiency by filing the corrected clauses or supplementary declarations; failure to cure results in automatic cancellation with a refund only of the 80% non-administrative fee portion.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Placement and Trade Register Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Commercial Registry Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the certified GAFI incorporation certificate and company data with the local Commercial Registry to obtain the trade register extract and commercial register number. This registration legalizes continuing commercial activity and creates a public record of company officers.
required_dossiers: GAFI Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of the notarized Memorandum and Articles
Approved quota-holder identity documents
Letters of appointment for managers and officers
Proof of physical registered-office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registry rejects the filing on grounds of incomplete documentation, the company may resubmit with a corrected covering letter; any underlying entity data discrepancies must first be rectified with GAFI before the Commercial Registry will process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Card, Tax Identification Number, and E-Invoicing Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After Commercial Registration, apply to the Egyptian Tax Authority for a Tax Card (physical or electronic) and obtain the unified Tax Identification Number (TIN). Register in the ETA's e-invoicing and e-receipt systems given the Amazon FBA business model. Complete the VAT registration assessment for import/export activity.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registry certificate and extract
GAFI incorporation certificate
Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
Identity documents of officers
Registered office lease agreement or title deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Tax Authority requests additional evidence of the registered office or actual activity, provide the lease contract, local bank letter, or Amazon FBA seller agreement; a formal appeal can be filed within 30 days of any denial.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance and Labor Unit Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance / GAFI One-Stop Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company as an employer with the competent social insurance office using the unified GAFI form, even where only remote management is planned. File a payroll declaration and register any officers who are Egyptian residents for mandatory social insurance contributions.
required_dossiers: Incorporation certificate and commercial registration certificate
Tax card or provisional TIN certificate
Board resolution appointing the responsible manager
Officer national IDs and employment declarations
Registered office lease
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Social Insurance office disputes the classification of a manager as a quota-holder or employee, submit the Articles and compensation minutes; a rectification request can be lodged under Law No. 63 of 2019.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Statutory Books Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Bank and GAFI/Commercial Registry Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the corporate bank account with the GAFI incorporation pack and board resolution. Activate the operating account for Amazon Pay, Stripe, or Airwallex settlement later. After opening, certify the company's statutory minute book, quota-share ledger, and management registers at the Commercial Registry or by a notary public as required in Egypt.
required_dossiers: Permission letter from GAFI for bank account opening, if requested
Certificate of incorporation and commercial register extract
Tax card and TIN certificate
Board resolution naming signatories
Original passports and residency cards of authorized signatories
Notarized Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank demands additional proof of economic activity, provide the Amazon seller central account statement or a draft marketplace agreement; if the bank rejects the signatory due to sanction-list screening, appoint an alternative compliant signatory by a new board resolution.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for pure Amazon FBA e-commerce retail. If physical warehousing or light assembly is later added, the competent authority is the General Authority for Industrial Development (GAID) under the Ministry of Trade and Industry.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating license is required for ISIC 4791 online marketplace retail. If a warehouse is operated, a municipal commercial operation license (Iza - Mahalliyat) and civil defense clearance will be needed.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for general online retail and storage of packaged goods; however, battery-containing or hazardous consumer goods storage may require a simplified hazardous-waste registration under Law No. 202 of 2020.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC discharge thresholds apply to non-manufacturing FBA activity. If operational warehousing exceeds a threshold, waste segregation and approved disposal under Waste Management Regulation Law No. 202 of 2020 must comply; any generator of hazardous waste must retain an approved waste-contractor agreement and submit a preliminary environmental registration form.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not mandatory for pure online retail with no physical premises; once any office or warehouse is procured, the Egyptian Civil Defense Authority must inspect and certify fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and electrical-safety plans, and the local labor authority must issue an occupational fitness and workplace safety clearance before staff are deployed.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) — official e-services portal https://www.eta.gov.eg; dedicated e-invoicing clearance platform https://invoicing.eta.gov.eg.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC must obtain a unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) by filing the Tax Card application (with the Unified Public Registration form) with the ETA within 30 days of commencing activity, either electronically through the ETA e-services portal or at the competent tax registration office. The statutory dossier comprises certified constitutional documents (Articles of Association), Commercial Registry extract, proof of legal address in Egypt, board resolution appointing a fiscal representative resident in Egypt, and KYC/AML identification of all non-resident beneficial owners. For VAT purposes the LLC files the VAT registration declaration under Article 15 of Law No. 67 of 2016 in parallel, after which the ETA issues a single Unified Tax Registration Certificate covering income tax, VAT, and stamp duty. Non-resident e-commerce operators without a local establishment must appoint an accredited Egyptian tax representative and obtain an ETA e-portal credential before making any taxable supply; however, this composite key assumes an Egyptian-incorporated LLC as the registered taxpayer.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The LLC is a resident juridical person under Law No. 91 of 2005, taxable at the standard 22.5% corporate income tax rate on worldwide income (foreign tax credit available), with no pass-through eligibility. The LLC is a separate taxable person for VAT under Law No. 67 of 2016. All Amazon marketplace revenue (ISIC 4791 cross-border retail) is booked as corporate income in Egypt. Territorial scope applies only to non-resident principals; no special economic zone or tax-holiday status is assumed for this general-case composite key.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt has no US-style 'check-the-box' election. Available mechanisms: (i) fiscal unity consolidated filing election under Article 48 of Law No. 91 of 2005 for resident companies with at least 95% common beneficial ownership, subject to ETA approval; (ii) VAT grouping is not permitted; each legal entity files independently; (iii) Double Tax Treaty relief election under Article 56 of the Income Tax Law for treaty-eligible foreign counterparties, subject to Egyptian substance and beneficial-ownership conditions; (iv) hybrid mismatch arrangements are re-characterized under Egyptian general anti-avoidance rules (Article 30(h) of Law No. 91 of 2005); (v) quarterly CIT instalment elections and an annual VAT refund settlement election are available for cash-flow management.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016 and its Executive Regulations
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover of goods and services for mandatory VAT registration (Article 15, Law 67/2016); registration due within 30 days of crossing the threshold; voluntary registration permitted below the threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt mandates real-time fiscal clearance of all B2B tax invoices through the ETA e-invoicing gateway, and e-receipts for B2C marketplace sales. The LLC must integrate its ERP with the ETA API (XML/JSON schemas), transmit every invoice/receipt for validation, obtain a unique ETA UUID and digital stamp, and affix the ETA-generated machine-readable QR code to paper copies. Invoices failing validation (invalid TIN, misclassified merchandise, missing nexus data) are automatically rejected and deemed non-issued, attracting statutory fines and audit penalties under Law No. 67 of 2016 as amended by Law No. 20 of 2023. The regime is fully digital; private invoice registers are not recognized for tax deduction purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating is available under Article 22 of Law No. 67 of 2016 for (i) tangible goods that physically leave Egyptian customs territory within 90 days of delivery/invoice date, and (ii) services performed within Egypt for a non-resident recipient whose benefit is not enjoyed in Egypt. For the Amazon FBA cross-border model, goods consigned by the Egyptian LLC to foreign fulfillment centers or directly to foreign consumers qualify provided the export contract, foreign-currency commercial invoice, and customs export declaration are all in the LLC's name and the LLC retains title and risk documentation. Recovered input VAT is first offset against output VAT; any excess refund is settled by the ETA within 45 days of documentary inspection per the VAT Executive Regulations.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Egypt Customs Authority) with ACI-compatible manifest link
Bill of Lading / airway bill / e-commerce logistics manifest evidencing physical removal from Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate or Egyptian bank foreign-currency purchase voucher documenting repatriation of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA operates a data-matching audit desk that reconciles customs manifests, e-invoicing clearance data, bank remittance logs, and VAT returns. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within the 180-day statutory window automatically reverses the 0% rate, triggering assessment of 14% VAT plus late-payment interest and a 100% additional-tax clawback (double VAT) for fraudulent or abusive zero-rating claims under Article 76 of Law No. 67 of 2016, in addition to criminal fines of EGP 20,000–100,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years for willful evasion. The retrospective assessment window is five years from the end of the relevant tax year; incomplete export documentation, absence of FX remittance certificates, or diversion of goods to local market consumption is treated as presumptive evidence of unlawful zero-rating, exposing the LLC to summary assessment, suspension of its e-invoicing license, and loss of VAT refund eligibility.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) — the sole monetary authority and bank prudential supervisor in Egypt; foreign-exchange activity is regulated under Law No. 194 of 2020 (the Foreign Exchange and Banking Law), CBE Board of Directors Decree No. 232 of 2021 (AML/CFT), and the CBE consolidated prudential rulebooks and periodic FX circulars. The CBE licenses all banks, approves correspondent relationships, operates the foreign-exchange interbank market, and receives all balance-of-payments reporting for export proceeds and capital flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: EGP operates as a market-determined managed float with onshore interbank convertibility; after the March 2024 CBE decision to liberalise the exchange-rate regime, the US dollar is freely traded against EGP inside the licensed banking system at the interbank price. Current-account flows — trade proceeds, e-commerce export receipts, commissions, and service fees — are executable at licensed banks with correct purpose-code documentation. Capital-account items — equity injections, external borrowings, dividend and interest remittances — are permitted but require documentary compliance: GAFI investment registration, bank FX files, ETA tax-clearance certificate for profit repatriation, and CBE inward/outward reporting. Residual hurdles: temporary bank-level USD cover constraints for unusually large outflows, mandatory execution through authorised banks, and absence of an offshore deliverable EGP market; genuine Amazon FBA export earnings, once collected through the authorised banking channel, are remittance-eligible without balance-of-payments restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory repatriation: 100% of Amazon and e-commerce export proceeds must be credited to an Egyptian licensed bank within 6 months from the date of shipment, extendable by up to an additional 6 months upon documented request to, or acceptance by, the CBE; the 6-month clock runs from the bill-of-lading date for goods and from the payment date for digital marketplace services. Conversion ratio: no fixed mandatory CBE surrender ratio remains after the 2016 float and the March 2024 liberalisation — exporters may lawfully hold receipts in foreign currency in a USD operational account or convert to EGP at the interbank rate. In practice, the receiving bank will match the export proceeds against the customer's FX demand file as a liquidity-discipline measure, not as a statutory conversion quota. Every Amazon payout must be reported by the bank under the CBE Balance-of-Payments export purpose code for merchant retail trade over the internet, and the bank maintains an export-proceeds file containing the e-invoices, Amazon settlement statements, and the credited dollar amount.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Blockage (Escrow) Account + EGP Current Account + USD Foreign-Currency Account
Capital Escrow/Blockage Account + Corporate Operational Account (EGP/USD)
Premium Corporate Treasury Package — USD Non-Resident Foreign-Currency Account + EGP Current Transaction Account; segregated capital escrow sub-ledger
Multi-Currency Corporate Operating Account (EGP, USD, EUR) + Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account Set (EGP/USD) + Capital Blockage Facility
Standard Current Account + FX Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: MEDIUM as a settlement rail, LOW as a treasury depository for EG_LLC. Foreign fintech EMIs — Airwallex, Payoneer, Stripe Connect, GKash — may collect Amazon marketplace payouts offshore in USD or EUR, but they are not licensed under Egyptian banking law (Law No. 194 of 2020 and Law No. 18 of 2019 on digital payment regulation) and cannot hold EGP domestic balances, open nostro accounts with Egyptian banks, or issue local Egyptian IBANs. Legally feasible architecture: offshore EMI commercial account for marketplace payouts, periodic sweeps via SWIFT MT103 to the Egyptian bank USD Non-Resident Foreign-Currency Account under purpose code 'e-commerce export proceeds', then conversion inside the interbank band. The 6-month CBE repatriation clock runs from each Amazon payment date, so the EMI balance must be swept at least monthly. Not feasible: using the EMI balance as the only treasury without local bank settlement, or paying Egyptian suppliers directly from an unlicensed EMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is the general CBE and bank-level standard: at least one director and all account-mandate signatories must appear in person at the Egyptian branch with original national IDs or passports; CBE AML/CFT Decree No. 232 of 2021 prescribes face-to-face identification, verification of authorised signatories, and identification of every Ultimate Beneficial Owner with 25% or more control. Video KYC is accepted by a few Tier-1 banks only for individually low-risk private clients and is not reliably available for a newly formed corporate with non-resident principals. Workable remote-opening path: appointment of an Egyptian-resident general manager or licensed local attorney under a notarised Power of Attorney that is apostilled (or legally attested by the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs) and accompanied by passport copies of all non-resident directors; conducting the compliance interview of foreign directors by video call at the bank branch while the POA holder is present; and submitting apostilled corporate registry extracts, board resolutions, and an economic-reason declaration. Each bank may still request an individual visit of the majority UBO during final due-diligence sign-off.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident 100% shareholding / foreign signatories without local presence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled and Egyptian-consular legalised Certificate of Incorporation or Memorandum of Association; board resolution authorising a local account-opening agent; notarised and attested Power of Attorney; UBO declaration identifying every beneficial owner with 25% or more control; personal and corporate source-of-funds statements covering at least 3 months; AML questionnaires; and individual and entity CVs of all shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Amazon FBA marketplace flows flagged as high-volume, cross-border, split-transaction or structuring risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amazon Merchant Central verification letter and settlement reports covering 6 months; payout statements from Airwallex or Payoneer with fee reports; FBA shipment loading instructions and customs clearance declarations; order-versus-refund reconciliation spreadsheets; supplier contracts and invoices evidencing commercial substance; and the company tax registration certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or counterparty appearing in sanctions, PEP, or negative-media screening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Approved sanctions-screening clear results; PEP attestation and breakdown of the full ownership chain to natural persons; negative-news search output; government-issued ID and proof-of-address for each UBO; and audited financial statements of any intermediate holding entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection mismatch versus GAFI-registered capital, or high foreign equity remittance without proof
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The bank's own Capital Blockage deposit certificate; GAFI investment certificate and commercial register extract; SWIFT MT103 remittance credit advices; interbank currency-conversion invoices; notarial declaration of the capital source; and the CBE inward-remittance registration report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export proceeds repatriation timeline breached or under-documented from the FX-control perspective
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shipment bills of lading and e-invoices from Egyptian customs; Amazon payout-date reports; foreign-bank credit advices; the bank's export-proceeds repatriation file; and, where the CBE electronic export documentation system applies, the registered export file proving arrival of 100% of proceeds in Egypt within the statutory 6-month (maximum 12-month) window.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for EG_LLC equity injection: (1) the non-resident shareholder instructs an SWIFT MT103 from its home bank to the Egyptian bank's New York or London correspondent, naming EG_LLC as beneficiary and placing 'Equity contribution — incorporation capital' in the purpose field, together with the CBE Balance-of-Payments direct-investment equity code; (2) the Egyptian bank credits a temporary USD Capital Blockage account and issues a capital-deposit certificate enabling GAFI to issue the commercial register; (3) after GAFI registration, the USD is either converted to EGP at the bank's daily interbank rate for operating needs or retained in the USD operational account; (4) the bank files the inward foreign-investment report with CBE and opens the treasury relationship for future guarantee and repatriation procedures. Compliance cautions: the wire amount must match the capital pledged to GAFI; any shareholder loan apart from equity requires CBE registration and debt-cover declaration forms; cash deposits above regulatory thresholds are unacceptable; all transfers require the full KYC dossiers described above.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For the FBA general model, the operative clearing-rail hierarchy is: (A) Cross-border supplier payments — SWIFT MT103 via the Egyptian bank's correspondent, debiting either the USD Foreign-Currency Account or EGP converted at interbank, recorded under CBE BoP purpose code for goods imports; each USD payment must be matched against documented FX source (Amazon export proceeds) in the bank's FX files. (B) Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP-600 — issued by an Egyptian Tier-1 bank for inventory purchase orders above USD 50,000, giving documentary risk mitigation and predictable FX planning; recurring small FBA lots are better served by direct wire because LC issuance cost outweighs benefit. (C) Domestic EGP payments — warehouse, freight-forwarding, local suppliers, and Egyptian tax payments — executed exclusively through EBS-RTGS (Egyptian Banks Society Real-Time Gross Settlement) and CBE-interfaced current accounts; domestic transactions must not be settled in USD. (D) Amazon platform fees, FBA fulfilment charges, and ocean/airfreight deductions — settled directly by Amazon from marketplace proceeds outside the Egyptian banking system and therefore not CBE-reportable outflows. All outbound FX disbursements are subject to the bank's FX-liquidity cover and the export-proceeds matching file.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/EGP outright forward — maturity up to 12 months, executed with an Egyptian licensed bank against documented trade exposure, physically delivered in the Egyptian interbank market.
USD/EGP FX swap — spot versus forward legs with a licensed local treasury counterparty, permitted for cash-flow hedging of expected e-commerce export proceeds and import payables.
Cross-currency interest-rate swap — available in combination with USD or EUR bank credit facilities to convert floating-rate external debt exposure into a covered EGP-equivalent hedging structure.
Exchange-listed USD/EGP futures — cash-settled contracts on the Egyptian Exchange (EGX, launched 2021), providing an exchange-cleared hedge instrument for resident corporates.

Offshore EGP NDF (negative boundary) — unavailable to Egyptian resident treasuries; Egypt maintains no onshore NDF market under CBE law, so EG_LLC must confine hedging to the deliverable instruments above, while non-resident counterparties may transact EGP NDFs only offshore.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) — competent tax office or Large Taxpayer Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the tax year end; for a calendar-year LLC, on or before 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 1% per commenced month on unpaid tax up to 100% of the tax; fixed administrative penalty of EGP 1,000–5,000 for non-filing; enforcement through tax liens and attachment orders.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited annual financial statements and shareholders' approval resolution deposited with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Office administered through the General Authority for Investment (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual general meeting approving the audited financial statements must be convened within 5 months of fiscal year-end; deposit with the Commercial Registry within 6 months of fiscal year-end (by 30 June for a 31 December year-end).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Contravention by the managers subject to a fine of EGP 2,000–20,000; suspension of commercial registration transactions; continued default may lead to administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Office of the competent district (trade registry and companies register under GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal must be completed during the first quarter (January–March) of each calendar year; annual fee is graduated by subscribed share capital.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal penalty of 10% of the annual fee per commenced month of delay; failure exceeding 60 days may suspend the commercial record and culminate in administrative strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) confirmation and update statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) under the national AML compliance framework
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due concurrently with the annual financial statements deposit (by 30 June for a calendar-year LLC); any material change in ownership or control must be reported within 15 days of entry in the Register of Members.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of EGP 20,000–100,000 for failure to maintain, update, or file UBO data; willful concealment carries criminal liability under AML Law 80/2002 as amended.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for LLCs with subscribed capital exceeding EGP 50,000; audit also mandatory upon request of any member or GAFI, and for taxpayers whose annual turnover triggers ETA substantive-verification requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), issued under Ministry of Finance Decree No. 110/2015 and aligned with IFRS; full IFRS is permissible for qualifying public interest entities and consolidation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain an on-site Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owners identifying any natural person who directly or indirectly owns 25% or more of the membership interests or exercises control. Annual confirmation is submitted to GAFI together with the audited financial statements; any transfer of membership interests must be recorded in the Register of Members prior to being opposable to third parties, and UBO changes must be communicated to GAFI within 15 days.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300–800 per year for an executive registered office and local compliance agent
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 700–2,500 for a cross-border e-commerce LLC with annual turnover up to USD 2 million

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic tax holiday for e-commerce. Investment Law 72/2017 offers investment cost deductions of 30% (Zone B) or 50% (Zone A) for qualified projects; free-zone entities may substitute CIT with a 1% annual charge on entry/exit value. SME turnover-based regimes can apply only to registered micro/small enterprises below statutory thresholds, not to ordinary LLCs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 4 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed via the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-filing portal at www.eta.gov.eg
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months after the fiscal year-end; for a 31 December year-end, filing and full payment are due by 30 April of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identification: legal name, commercial registration number, tax card number, SME code, head office address and fiscal year-end date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the LLC's Egyptian TIN; if foreign-owned, also list the immediate parent's legal form, jurisdiction, registered address and parent TIN or foreign tax identification number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal representative details: director/general manager full name, national ID or passport, residence, position and board authorization reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident director, supply passport particulars, country of residence and a notarized Arabic power of attorney; attach ETA registration proof or a director residency waiver.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating revenue: gross Amazon FBA sales, commissions, marketplace payouts, allowances, returned goods, chargebacks and other e-commerce income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all sales generated through Egyptian IP addresses, delivery addresses in Egypt, or orders emanating from an Egyptian permanent establishment; offshore settlement does not remove Egyptian taxability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign income: dividends from foreign subsidiaries, foreign bank interest, foreign royalties and income attributable to branches abroad.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the source country and nature of each foreign income item; attach a treaty relief form and a tax residency certificate if a DTA credit or exemption is claimed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses: cost of goods sold, FBA fees, storage, shipping, payment-gateway charges, advertising, software subscriptions, depreciation, and the permitted carryforward of prior-year tax losses (maximum 5 years).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For payments to non-resident affiliates (licensing, service or financing), attach intercompany agreements and contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation; missing documentation may trigger a 30% penalty on any adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculated taxable profit: net accounting profit plus non-deductible expenses minus exempt income and treaty-creditable items.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Separately disclose any deemed distribution or strong payment to a foreign shareholder and the resulting withholding tax liability, with cross-references to Box 7.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax computation: taxable profit at 22.5%, less advance tax payments, foreign tax credits and final withholding taxes; shows the balance payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure the balance is paid by the deadline; if the LLC already withheld 10% dividend tax on any distributed amount, attach proof of deposit to the ETA account.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts an administrative fine of EGP 500-5,000 for the first violation, rising to EGP 20,000 on a repeat. Late payment triggers a 2% monthly delay tax on the unpaid amount, capped at 40% of the tax due. Incorrect or fraudulent returns can result in a criminal fine of up to twice the evaded tax, imprisonment, suspension of the commercial registration and bank account freezes.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final tax withheld at source on gross dividends paid by an Egyptian LLC, applicable to both resident and non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced DTA rate, the non-resident beneficial owner must deliver to the Egyptian LLC before distribution: a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) for the relevant period, a signed beneficial ownership declaration, and a specific treaty article citation. The LLC must file a prior-approval request with the ETA International Taxation Department at least 30 days before the payment date. If no approval is obtained by payment, 10% is withheld and the non-resident can apply for a refund within 5 years, attaching the TRC, ownership statements and proof of Egyptian withholding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory withholding rates are 20% for royalties and 20% for interest paid to non-residents. Under many Egyptian DTAs, royalty rates are reduced to 10%-15% and interest rates to 10%-15%, with certain categories of government or pension-fund interest exempted. Treaty reductions require the same TRC and ETA prior-approval procedure as dividend relief.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 5,000,000 aggregate annual related-party transactions triggers mandatory Local File and Master File preparation; a Transfer Pricing Information Schedule must accompany the annual CIT return whenever related-party transactions exceed EGP 1,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt has no separate Economic Substance Regulations like Gulf jurisdictions. However, Article 77 of Income Tax Law No. 91/2005 empowers the ETA to disregard transactions or entities that lack commercial substance and are designed purely for tax avoidance. An e-commerce LLC must maintain a physical office, operational staff, genuine stock and logistics monitoring, dated board minutes, a dedicated bank account, and complete accounting ledgers; otherwise it can be recharacterized as a conduit or sham and its profits re-attributed to the foreign parent.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing Amazon seller statements, under-declaring Amazon payouts, using personal bank accounts to receive customer refunds, or fabricating invoices to reduce taxable income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of 2-5 years and/or a fine of not less than EGP 10,000 and not more than twice the tax evaded; additional 2% monthly delay tax up to 40%; automatic turnover-based tax assessment; seizure of sale proceeds and commercial registration suspension.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, CFO and tax preparer are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax and penalties; personal assets are attachable; ETA may issue travel bans; a criminal conviction may preclude holding a director position in Egypt.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The LLC has no physical office, no employees, no local inventory or operational capacity, and immediately distributes revenue to a foreign parent as royalties, commissions or mark-ups without economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA invokes Article 77 of Law 91/2005 to disregard the entity; re-attributes 100% of the B2C e-commerce profit to the foreign shareholder; assesses 22.5% CIT plus 20% deemed dividend withholding tax and monthly delay tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution for the full avoided CIT and WHT; corporate veil piercing makes directors personally liable; assets are frozen, travel restrictions are imposed and active participants face up to two years' imprisonment for tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Undocumented Cross-Border Royalty and Interest Payments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying Amazon software royalties, brand license fees, management fees or interest to UAE/Chinese affiliates without signed agreements, transfer pricing benchmarking, or 20% withholding at source.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disallowance of the deduction; mandatory assessment of 20% withholding tax on the gross payment; up to 100% penalty on the unpaid WHT; transfer pricing adjustment can trigger an additional 30% penalty under TP regulations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors become co-obligors under Articles 58 and 60 of Law 91; personal assets can be attached if the LLC is insolvent; travel bans are issued; deliberate under-withholding results in criminal referral and possible imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving Amazon proceeds through unlicensed remittance networks, structuring multiple bank deposits to stay below reporting thresholds, or failing to register e-commerce cash flows with the financial intelligence unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under AML Law No. 80/2002, fines from EGP 100,000 to 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years for laundering commercial proceeds; court-ordered freezing and confiscation of all linked bank balances; permanent revocation of commercial registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally prosecuted even after corporate dissolution; passports are surrendered; civil disgorgement of funds routed through informal systems is ordered; travel declarations are restricted and imprisonment is possible upon conviction.
